answer: Each participant bonds 25 POA for twelve epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly drawn reviewers who share no funder and no earlier co-review history. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger is public: a yarrow-like spread of independent signatures proves real work, an echo of reused evidence exposes copied submissions, and a hollow record with no verified tenure cannot unlock premium tasks. Every extra sybil needs its own bond, jobs, and reviewers, so cloning costs more than honest labour.
